title: KC Differential Gene Expression: Tissue
bodyHtml: Click the Research Method tab to find full details about datasets, tissues, phenotypes, and analysis methods and to see potential next steps after obtaining DE results.
dataVisualizerLegendHtml: In the plot below, dots represent the DE values for the tissue you have selected; larger dots indicate higher mean expression. Hover over a dot to see its underlying data. Dots are colored in gray (nonsignificant values on both axes), green (significant values on one axis only), or red (significant values on both axes).
